title: PaperTree internal paper tools (agent -> API, contracts.md §4)
description: HAND-WRITTEN from contracts.md §4 (reader release S0). The agent's four read-only tools, served by the API at /internal/agent/runs/{run_id}/... to loopback callers only, with `Authorization: Bearer <run token>` checked through run_grant. Routes: get_outline() -> GET .../outline; get_section({handle, cursor?}) -> GET .../sections/{handle}?cursor=; get_passage({handle}) -> GET .../passages/{handle}; search_passages({query, limit <= 8}) -> GET .../search?q=&limit= (on zero hits it returns the outline). The `*Params` defs are the TypeBox parameter shapes the agent registers; every 200 is a ToolResult; errors are 401 auth_required (bad or expired token), 404 not_found (unknown handle: the agent's tool throws 'Passage bN is not available.') and 429 tool_budget_exhausted (the 17th request of a run). The API's pydantic ToolResult is exported in contracts/api/internal.schema.json.

ToolResult.description: `text` is model-facing, datamarked with the run's datamark; every block in it is headed `[bN] (p. {page_label} · {section title} · {type})`. `handles` are the handles this response introduced, first-seen, persisted to ai_run_handles.

ToolError.description: The contracts.md §0 envelope. NOTE: `tool_budget_exhausted` is a run error code (§2.9's second list), not a member of the API's ErrorCode enum; which enum the 429 draws from is an open contracts question (S0 report).
